description: License texts for npm packages bundled into the console whose published tarballs ship no license file. scripts/build_console.py publishes a text only for a package@version that the bundler reports without license text, only when the declared identifier matches, and fails when an entry is stale or its file digest differs.

supplements.note: Repository LICENSE at the commit recorded as gitHead in the published package metadata.
Published from the same repository and gitHead as @uiw/react-codemirror; the repository LICENSE at that commit covers it.

The v3.0.1 release commit and its npm tarball contain no license file (package.json and README declare MIT); this is the upstream repository LICENSE added afterwards in commit a2659e6, whose copyright line carries the later year.
